notes.title: Contribute to the clean future with Global City!
notes.content:
🌿 The Future is Green: Ecological Cities 🌍

Did you know that some cities are leading the way in sustainability? 🌱 Take Singapore, for example—it's a "City in a Garden." 🌳 With over 50% of its urban area covered in greenery, Singapore is a global example of how to blend nature with city life.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41543593/b66ea8598a2d0fc606897fd26414347c128233c9.png

What makes Singapore even more impressive is its water management system. 🌊 They recycle 40% of their water and use innovative technologies to reduce pollution in rivers and oceans, making it a model for fighting water pollution across the world! 💧

In Global City, we’re bringing that inspiration to life! 🌍 Our Protect the Ocean collaboration with dots.eco lets you contribute to reducing ocean pollution while supporting real eco-projects. 

Want to help make the world a better place? Join us in Global City today!🌿

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1731270/Global_City/

notes.title: 🌍 What is Plastic Footprint? 🌊
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41543593/82ab0fd1f9c8d07936332bb5928a5a866d2371fa.png

Plastic footprint is the amount of plastic waste we generate and leave behind in the environment. Every plastic bag, bottle, and straw we use adds to this growing problem, and unfortunately, a lot of it ends up in the ocean.

🐢 Which species are in danger? It’s not just turtles who mistake plastic for food. Dolphins can get tangled in discarded fishing nets, and seabirds often feed plastic pieces to their young. Even the tiniest creatures, like plankton, are at risk, as they ingest microplastics that work their way up the food chain, impacting ecosystems far beyond the ocean depths. The plastic doesn't just disappear—it spreads.

🌊 Our oceans are in danger, and with them, so are we. The plastic footprint we leave behind grows every day. But here's the question: How can we reduce it?

💡 Tell us in the comments how YOU think we can lower our plastic footprint! One easy way is by using reusable bottles—oh, and maybe playing Global City? 😉 For those who share their ideas, there just might be a reward waiting for you! 🎁
